# Osprey — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the scientific name of the Osprey?", "Pandion haliaetus"),
    ("What does the Osprey eat?", "fish"),
    ("What is scientific name?", "Pandion haliaetus"),
    ("What is size?", "60 cm"),
    ("What is habitat?", "near water worldwide"),
    ("What is diet?", "fish"),
    ("What is range?", "worldwide"),
    ("What is notable?", "Reversible talons; dives feet-first"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
